reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Composition v1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.mode`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: Composition resources with spec.mode set to 'Resources' will be rejected by the API server because this enum value is no longer allowed.

proposed.statement: The allowed enum value "Resources" for spec.mode in Composition resources is removed and will be rejected by the API server.
